description: This file defines a static class `GlyphTypefaceCache` within the `PdfSharp.Fonts.OpenType` namespace. It manages a cache of glyph typefaces, providing methods to retrieve, add, reset, and inspect the cache contents. The class interacts with global font storage and ensures thread safety via locking mechanisms.

classes.name: GlyphTypefaceCache
classes.description: A static class that manages cached glyph typefaces, allowing lookups, insertions, cache clearing, and state inspection.

methods.name: TryGetGlyphTypeface
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a glyph typeface by key; returns true if found, false otherwise.

methods.name: AddGlyphTypeface
methods.description: Adds a new glyph typeface to the cache, ensuring thread safety and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears all entries in the glyph typeface cache.

methods.name: GetCacheState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current state of the glyph typeface cache for debugging purposes.
